row.notes: (int *slot): TlsGetValue(*slot) when the slot is allocated; when slot == -1 it lazily TlsAlloc's the errno-context slot 0x1461089d0, writes error code 1 into every node of the per-thread error-context chain (node+0 code, node+8 next) and records the return address + code into g_Ne_ErrnoTraceRing 0x146107830 when g_Ne_ErrnoTraceOn is set for this thread; returns 0. Every engine helper that reports errno inlines this (code values: 2 not found, 0xe no memory, 0x16 invalid, 0x54 truncated).
